claims.statement: The lease is classified as an operating lease under ASC 842-10-25-2: no transfer of ownership, no purchase option reasonably certain of exercise, the 36-month term is not a major part of the asset's economic life, and the present value of payments is not substantially all of the asset's fair value.

The initial lease liability is measured at the present value of 36 monthly payments of 10,000 USD discounted at 6.0% per annum (approximately 328,710 USD), and the ROU asset equals the initial liability with no incentives, prepaid rent, or initial direct costs in this stub.
claims.conclusion: Initial measurement ties to the present value calculation, pending discount rate support.
